title: Effectiveness of Routine Sterile Gloving in Blood Culture
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether routine sterile gloving can lower contamination rates in blood culture.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The patients in whom Blood culture is medically needed

Exclusion Criteria:

* Blood sample is obtained through central venous catheter or arterial line
* No consent to this study
